description: Scientists have recently uncovered a small dinosaur named Infernogallus jamesi, believed to have predominantly dined on fruit. description: Frederick Wells discovered the enormous Cullinan diamond in South Africa in 1905 while working at the Premier Mine. description: Claude-maker Anthropic's engineering manager Felix Rieseberg has stopped giving coding interviews, saying Claude is now better at them. The advice comes as AI-driven layoffs hit entry-level tech jobs the hardest.

description: The Karnataka Cabinet has sanctioned an increase in milk prices by Rs 8 per litre, set to commence on November 1. This adjustment will grant farmers an additional Rs 7 per litre, while cooperatives will benefit from Re 1. Farmers, who currently earn Rs 35 per litre, will see their income boosted to Rs 42.

description: Waqar Younis praised Jasprit Bumrah’s remarkable skills in white-ball formats but raised questions about his Test career achievements. Although Bumrah maintains a solid Test record, concerns linger due to his limited appearances caused by injuries. Younis emphasized Bumrah’s pivotal moments, especially during the T20 World Cup against Pakistan, while anticipating his return for the upcoming Test series against New Zealand next month.

author: RK LAXMI
description: On October 26, a woman named Priya allegedly conspired with her gym trainer lover to stab her husband. CCTVs captured Priya leaving their home in Ghaziabad shortly before the attack occurred. The attack was brutal, happening while Shashank was asleep next to their young daughter. Shashank was immediately rushed to the intensive care unit after suffering severe injuries. Both Priya and her accomplice have been arrested and face multiple charges.

description: According to the recordings published by Spanish outlets including El País and RTVE, a technical problem had disrupted the automatic signalling system, forcing trains on the affected stretch to stop. The system helps control train movements and prevents trains from entering sections of track when it may be unsafe to do so.
title: Spain train crash: Audio reveals chilling exchange before deadly collision

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Mumbai Indians have parted ways with coaches Lasith Malinga, Paras Mhambrey and Carl Hopkinson ahead of IPL 2027. Malinga contributed to four IPL titles, while Mhambrey helped develop the team’s bowling talent and Hopkinson worked on fielding standards. The exits follow Mahela Jayawardene’s departure after mixed results in his second stint as head coach.
title: Big shake-up! MI confirm exits of three coaches, including Malinga

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Ladli Khatoon from Bahwanpur, Bihar, has transformed her family's tragedy into a solar irrigation venture. After losing her son, she discovered the risks of conventional irrigation methods and sought alternatives. Through support from JEEViKA and local organizations, she established a solar irrigation business, benefiting many farmers. This initiative has enabled several women to earn incomes and gain respect in their communities.
title: Bihar woman loses son to electric shock, starts solar irrigation for 38 farmers

author: etimes.in
description: Advocate V Akathiyan made a significant visit to Vayaloor village to aid 30 tribal families in acquiring overdue caste certificates, essential for expanding educational and job prospects. One of the beneficiaries, M Manikandan, secured a government clerk role thanks to the certificate. Akathiyan’s dedication also encompasses more tribal regions, addressing legal issues and fundamental necessities, showcasing how essential documentation can drive social equity.
title: Tea shop worker turned lawyer helps 30 tribal families, one lands govt job

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: After a price cut from $6.99 million, Richard Simmons' Sunset Strip estate has sold for $3.827 million. Initially listed in June 2025, the Colonial-style house piqued interest but failed to secure deals until now. The new buyer aims to preserve the home’s historical charm and scenic vistas while contemplating redevelopment in this sought-after area.
title: Richard Simmons' Hollywood Hills home sells for $3.8m after $6.99m listing

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Allahabad high court has made a significant decision by siding with an unmarried sister in an insurance claim case, ordering Oriental Insurance Company to pay her Rs 5 lakh after her brother's death. Initially denied coverage due to her not being designated as a family member, the court made it clear that beneficiaries with documentation are entitled to benefits no matter the familial definitions.
title: Insurance firm denied Rs 5 lakh to sister after brother's death, Allahabad HC overrules

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: WhatsApp co-founder Jan Koum's $36 million donation has helped Milken Community School open a new campus in Bel Air, Los Angeles, for students in grades 9 to 12. Inaugurated on Sunday, the campus has expanded the school's total footprint to 28 acres across three locations. The opening comes as the school reports a 40% rise in applications.
title: WhatsApp co-founder Jan Koum's $36m gift helps open new LA school campus

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Sujeet Kalkal’s wait for a World Championships medal continued as the Indian wrestler suffered a heartbreaking defeat in the men’s 65kg quarterfinals on Thursday. Sujeet lost 3-3 on criteria to Tajikistan’s Abdulmazhid Kudiev, bringing his 24-match winning streak to an end.
title: 24 wins, 7 titles, 1 heartbreaking defeat: Wrestler Kalkal's winning streak ends

author: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE
description: While the BJP-led NDA won big in the MLC elections across four states, it suffered setbacks in two politically significant constituencies: Nagpur and Varanasi where the Congress and SP held their ground.

description: Kannan N Ramakrishnan, who has been assisting people with grievances for nearly three decades, remains dedicated to public service. He transforms individuals' concerns into written petitions to present to government officials. Throughout his efforts, he has submitted over 5,000 petitions and covered a range of issues from civic problems to welfare benefits. Despite some petitions not yielding results, he finds satisfaction in helping others express their concerns.

description: Researchers at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology have found that JAK inhibitors may weaken the body's defenses. These drugs can increase vulnerability to viral infections, such as COVID-19 and influenza. By suppressing immune responses, these medications facilitate easier spread of viruses within the body. Caution is advised for healthcare professionals when prescribing these drugs during outbreaks.
title: Common anti-inflammatory drugs may help flu, COVID viruses spread: study

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer in Haryana sought redress after Mahindra & Mahindra failed to deliver a booked SUV. The booking was made in February 2022, but the vehicle was never delivered to the customer. The manufacturer and dealer provided contradictory claims regarding the situation surrounding the delayed delivery. Consequently, the consumer commission found both parties guilty of unfair trade practices and ordered compensation.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A nine-year property dispute over access to Minnesota's Prairie Lake has taken another turn after an appeals court upheld a ruling in favour of the Blackwood Trust. The Monday decision confirms the trust's direct access to the lake and leaves an earlier $148,500 trespass award to neighbouring property owners cancelled. The dispute centred on conflicting land surveys dating back to 1997.
title: Appeals court backs Prairie Lake access, overturns $148K trespass award

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: US government has declared a national emergency to address security risks posed by foreign-made electricity equipment. An executive order has been signed, allowing tighter restrictions on potentially dangerous foreign equipment. The new measures aim to protect the national grid from cyberattacks and supply disruptions. This initiative could also boost domestic manufacturers as reliance on potentially vulnerable foreign suppliers is reduced.
title: US declares national emergency to secure power grid; what it means for Americans

description: Two sisters from Madhya Pradesh committed suicide by jumping into wells with their children on Wednesday. Anjali Rawat, who was eight months pregnant, took her son Prashant with her while Sita Rawat jumped with her three children. Family members reported the incidents after not seeing them return home. Each sister was profoundly impacted by personal tragedies occurring shortly before these events.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Esmée Gummer was left paralysed from the waist down after a surgery at the age of 18. She gradually learned to walk again, which later led her to discover a passion for running. Gummer completed a 5,000-km journey across the UK and Ireland, running for 99 consecutive days. As part of her initiative, she organized 76 inclusive running clubs that welcomed nearly 6,700 participants.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A new study indicates that early access to language is crucial for children's understanding of numbers. Deaf children with exposure to sign language from birth perform similarly to hearing children learning spoken language. Researchers assessed various children, highlighting the importance of language in early development. The findings suggest that both signed and spoken languages foster academic skills, including mathematics.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In Florida, Sandra Moise faced significant challenges when her home was damaged due to vibrations from nearby demolition activities. Initially, her insurance provider, Homeowners Choice, denied her claim citing policy exclusions against earth movement. After enduring a prolonged legal battle, a jury ultimately sided with her, confirming the damage's cause.
title: Florida appeals court backs Miami woman in 12-year fight over home damage

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Rajinikanth's blockbuster 'Jailer 2' has made waves at the Indian box office, starting with an impressive Rs 59.70 crore on its opening day. Its first week saw robust earnings, and even with some daily revenue dips in the third week, it has achieved an extraordinary total of over Rs 424 crore. The future will reveal if it can soar to the coveted Rs 1,000 crore mark.

description: Protests against the dam at the Dite-Dime bridge have prompted a strong response from law enforcement. The Central Armed Police Forces have been deployed to ensure order in the affected districts. Recent confrontations during a bandh left several people injured, including four women, escalating tensions. As supporters clashed with security, the Dite-Dime bridge emerges as a focal point of strife near the India-China border.

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Nike has entered into a multi-year partnership with Mumbai Indians to supply kits from 2027. This partnership marks Nike's return to the IPL after almost two decades. The new gear will be presented to MI's teams ahead of their upcoming seasons. This move signifies Nike’s renewed commitment to the cricket market in India and reflects the growing demand for quality sports merchandise.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A California couple who bought a home in 2019 found themselves in a legal battle after their neighbour claimed ownership of a 20-by-20-foot garden they believed was theirs. The dispute centred on a 1955 agreement involving $250, babysitting services and land access rights. On Monday, a California appeals court upheld the couple's exclusive right to use the garden.
title: California couple wins garden rights after neighbour’s 1955 deal for $250

author: SUHAS BIRHADE
description: Three siblings were discovered dead in their Virar flat, believed to have died by suicide. They recorded a video mentioning their health issues and financial troubles prior to their deaths. Residents noticed a foul smell and alerted the police, leading to the discovery of the bodies. One sibling suffered paralysis while another was undergoing cancer treatment, compounding their difficulties.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Google reported its Q3 2026 financial results, highlighting a 25% revenue growth and a run rate of half a trillion dollars. However, the company missed profit projections and experienced a stock decline of nearly 10%. Alphabet's negative free cash flow reached $9.07 billion, indicating financial challenges for the tech giant. Significant capital expenditures of $51.36 billion further raised investor concerns about cash burn.

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Waqar Younis participated in a rapid-fire segment where he selected Indian players over Pakistani counterparts. He chose Sachin Tendulkar, Virat Kohli, and MS Dhoni for their respective roles in the game. Waqar only selected Saeed Anwar as his preference over Virender Sehwag among the comparisons. He declined to choose between young players Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Sameer Minhas due to insufficient observation.

The student accepted a ride home, and after dropping off a friend, the accused reportedly made inappropriate advances while driving. The Defence officials announced plans to establish a ground-based missile defence capability by the early 2030s. They cited lessons learned from warfare in Ukraine and the Middle East as key considerations. Options under discussion include the US Patriot missile system and Iron Dome interceptors manufactured by Rafael.

With nine fatalities reported in Andhra Pradesh, evacuations were necessary, and significant crop damage affected about 2 lakh hectares. Restoration work is underway, with unwavering support from the central government for the affected regions.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A groundbreaking conservation project has successfully preserved 181 acres of forests and wetlands straddling Maryland and Delaware. Championed by the Porter family alongside multiple conservation entities, the Henry F. Porter Preserve focuses on safeguarding vital ecosystems. This initiative not only emphasizes sustainable practices but also plays a pivotal role in the overall protection of the Chesapeake Bay watershed.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Hendersonville celebrates the successful completion of the first phase of its Lower Mud Creek Floodplain Restoration Project. This significant endeavor aims to mitigate flood risks for surrounding properties, boosting community safety. Key efforts include reconnecting Mud Creek with its floodplain to enhance water quality and flood management. Financial support from various organizations has been crucial in the project's design and construction.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A 61-year-old man in France has tragically lost his life to the Shamonda virus, a disease previously only observed in animals. The man, who was battling leukaemia, contracted the virus likely through a midge bite. With documented cases of infected animals in Europe and previous outbreaks in Africa and Asia, health officials are investigating how the virus spreads and its possible risks to humans.

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: West Delhi consumer commission found Bank of Baroda guilty of deficiency in service for unauthorized transactions. The commission specified that the bank did not provide necessary evidence to establish customer responsibility. Arun Kumar reported four unauthorized withdrawals totaling Rs 38,649 from his bank account in July 2019. The bank was directed to refund this amount along with additional compensation within 30 days.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A dispute between a couple and their neighbour escalated into serious harassment concerning driveway access and utilities. The couple claimed that their neighbour blocked the shared driveway and cut off their water supply. This pattern of interference led them to seek legal protection from the court. The Washington Court of Appeals confirmed that their claims warranted an anti-harassment order.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has praised Germany, Japan, and China as the frontrunners in manufacturing. He pointed out that China's rapid industrial advancement coincided with the emergence of computing technologies. Huang emphasized that US sanctions have driven a substantial surge in China’s domestic semiconductor production, positioning China uniquely with strengths in both manufacturing and computer science. Conversely, American tech companies remain equipped to tackle the challenges of international competition.

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Tax disputes ended the Indian Grand Prix after three races. Thirteen years later, the government has put Formula 1 back on its agenda, with a task force examining the challenges that led to the sport’s exit, including taxation, import duties and commercial arrangements. As India targets a possible 2028 return, the big question is whether it can put the right framework in place for F1 to return - and stay.

Christina Kent and Francis Shepherd have used around 100,000 bricks to construct the 27-room Castle Phoenix, which stands 17 metres tall. Despite financial and health challenges, only three of its eight turrets are complete, and their wedding remains on hold.

They have submitted a request for a certificate of lawfulness to transform the structure, initially approved as a swimming-pool pavilion, into residential quarters. description: Cristiano Ronaldo has been named the first-ever winner of the BOAT award for his 2008 season. Fans voted in a digital process that compared his performance to Lionel Messi's seasons. The award highlights the ongoing rivalry between these two football legends in history.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a landmark decision, a Michigan court has affirmed a nearly $9.7 million ruling against Henry Ford Macomb Hospital for negligence that led to Cathleen Allen's tragic death after cosmetic surgery complications. Medical testimony highlighted that prompt action could have preserved her life. The jury attributed liability to both the surgeon and hospital, underscoring the urgent need for stringent patient safety measures.

description: In early trading on Thursday, the rupee gained 11 paise against the US dollar, reaching 95.17. This uptick followed the US Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates steady, causing a weakening of the dollar as traders reacted negatively. Observers are now focused on upcoming economic data, especially regarding inflation and potential rate adjustments. Notably, Foreign Institutional Investors have been actively purchasing Indian equities, reflecting a positive market outlook.

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: In the third T20I against New Zealand in Wellington, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashed 45 runs off just 19 balls, giving India a flying start in their chase of 199. At the other end, Abhishek Sharma played a sensational knock of 113 off 38 balls. The opening pair added 133 runs in just 7.1 overs as India reached the target in 13.2 overs, winning by six wickets and taking an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series.

His 17-year-old son allegedly drove a car during the incident in Kochi. The police interrogated the judge for several hours before issuing further notice for questioning. The judges' conduct has been questioned, leading the victim's family to seek an inquiry.

author: TNN
description: The Uttar Pradesh government has updated its character verification rules for selected candidates in direct recruitment. Candidates involved in violent activities aiming for regime change could be denied government jobs. However, political ideology alone cannot disqualify individuals from employment. The mere registration of an FIR or ongoing investigations will not automatically make candidates ineligible. Decisions on eligibility will depend on specific circumstances related to the verification rules.

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Fifteen-year-old cricketer Uma Kashvi from Karnataka has made waves in the WPL auction by signing with Delhi Capitals, marking her as the youngest player ever sold. Known for her extraordinary talent, she scored an unbeaten double century at just twelve years old. With a history of leadership and playing for India Under-19, Delhi Capitals views her acquisition as a strategic move for long-term growth in cricket.

description: Engineers at MIT have created a new construction method inspired by origami, utilizing folded aluminium sheets. This technique allows for the design of lightweight, rigid structures that bear loads efficiently without internal support. Researchers have demonstrated this approach with a large sculpture displayed in a public library atrium. The method could revolutionize construction by simplifying assembly and reducing material use.

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: During inquiry, a woman who had brought Yadav to the hospital told police she had been friends with him since Dec 2025. According to her statement, she went to Sonipat on Oct 27 to meet Yadav and tell him she could no longer remain in touch with him. She told police Yadav later dropped her off at Maujpur in his SUV. Around 9pm, when the woman returned to the area near Gate No. 1 of Maujpur metro station to check on him, she found him lying on the road beside his vehicle and rushed him to hospital.
title: Neeraj Yadav death: Woman friend says she met him hours before he was found beside SUV

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Prince William inherited the Duchy of Cornwall after Queen Elizabeth II’s death in 2022. The 128,000-acre estate is valued at $1.3 billion and provides him with nearly $31 million in annual private income. He now plans to sell 20% of its assets to fund housing, nature recovery and renewable energy projects across key communities.
title: Prince William to sell 20% of $1.3B Duchy to fund housing projects

author: AMBIKA PANDIT
description: India Biennale 2026 is set to occur from December 4 to March 21 across various monuments. Jantar Mantar will be used as a venue, marking its first major event since being designated a no protest zone. Nine countries have confirmed their participation in this ambitious exhibition. The event aims to integrate art, architecture, and design from India and beyond.
title: Jantar Mantar to be prime venue for India Biennale

author: TNN
description: Minder Gurmit Singh Thukral reacted inappropriately after the court ruled against her and her children. Following an eviction order, Thukral and her family returned to the property afterward. The Bombay High Court deemed her actions as contempt of court during the contempt petition proceedings. She attempted to throw her purse at the judge but ultimately restrained herself and apologized.
title: Woman tries to hurl purse at judge after eviction order goes against her

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Around 300 demonstrators gathered in Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and Haifa to demand a Jewish-Arab government. Protesters held signs advocating for freedom and inclusive governance, reflecting their unified call. The demonstrations coincided with ongoing vote counting following Israel's closely contested election. Pro-Netanyahu parties secured 53 seats, while the opposing bloc held 48, leaving no clear majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot emphasized a need for change, criticizing Netanyahu's government.
title: 'From the river to the sea': Hundreds rally across Israel advocating Jewish-Arab gov

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Gisele Bündchen is reportedly unfazed by Tom Brady’s rumored romance with fellow Victoria’s Secret model Candice Swanepoel. According to an unnamed insider, Bündchen has no interest in monitoring her ex-husband’s dating life or comparing herself with Swanepoel. The former couple, who divorced in 2022, share two children, Benjamin and Vivian. The source claims Bündchen remains focused on her children and personal life, while Brady’s romantic choices remain his own business.
title: Gisele Bündchen reacts amid Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel dating rumors

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' co-owned KC Current will launch Light Up The Pitch, its first walk-through holiday light experience, at CPKC Stadium in Kansas City. Starting November 27, the five-weekend event will feature a 26-foot Christmas tree, teal light displays, a train depot and a larger-than-life Santa. Visitors can explore the festive attraction in about an hour, giving families a new holiday destination beyond the soccer season.
title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany's KC Current to launch holiday light experience

author: TNN
description: Aarti Soni, along with her children Nilkanth and Jainy, was found dead in their home. The domestic worker's concern led to the discovery of the bodies hanging from a ceiling fan. Investigators suspect the deaths occurred several days prior due to a foul smell. Aarti had recently made plans to expand her family's Ayurveda hospital, which they managed after her husband's death.
title: Mystery surrounds deaths of Ayurveda hospital owner, son, daughter

author: HADI KHAN
description: Abhijeet Wanjari from Congress has retained the Nagpur Division Graduates' constituency seat after a tight election. He defeated BJP's Sudhakar Kohale by 3,271 votes following over 40 hours of counting. Kohale initially led during the second round of counting but Wanjari eventually prevailed. The elections for Maharashtra legislative council were conducted for five constituencies, reflecting some differences within the ruling Mahayuti alliance.
title: In setback to BJP, Congress wins Nagpur MLC seat

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Donald Trump's Truth API, a subscription-based social media service, is attracting a diverse clientele, including Bloomberg and various trading firms, by offering rapid access to his posts. This service's growing popularity raises ethical questions about the commercialization of presidential communication and its potential effects on market dynamics. Amid ongoing legal challenges and mounting criticism, Trump's media company faces heightened scrutiny due to its reduced market value and controversial business practices.
title: 3 Wall Street firms agree to pay up to $100,000 a month to get Trump’s posts faster

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In a market shaken by geopolitical tensions, oil prices saw a downturn as traders considered possible U.S.-Iran diplomatic actions against the backdrop of supply disruption risks. Brent crude prices slipped by 0.74%, while WTI dropped by 0.89%. The recent assaults by Yemen's Houthis have further complicated the already uncertain market landscape. Mixed signals from U.S. inventory reports only added to the volatility affecting crude oil valuations.
title: Oil prices slip as peace hopes ease supply fears, Middle East tensions limit losses

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: As Karwa Chauth draws near on October 29, 2026, messages of goodwill and affection circulate among family and friends. This cherished festival fosters profound bonds through collective fasting and devotion. Tailored greetings fly between partners, relatives, and colleagues, all celebrating love. As the moon rises, the essence of unity and heartfelt expressions of care permeate the festivities.
title: 75+ Happy Karwa Chauth messages, wishes, greetings and quotes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Bowen Wang, a 12-year-old student from California, has won a national technology prize for his innovative work. He created an artificial intelligence tool called Aftershock Oracle that forecasts earthquake aftershocks. This project utilized decades of data from the United States Geological Survey to make accurate predictions. Bowen's achievement highlights the potential of young researchers in STEM fields. He plans to pursue a career in civil engineering focusing on sustainable design.
title: Meet Bowen Wang: Seventh grader wins $3,500 for AI aftershock prediction too

author: YASHIKA BAJAJ
description: A yellow alert has been issued for rain and thunderstorms in Delhi-NCR for Thursday and Friday. The IMD forecasts a generally cloudy sky with winds reaching 40-50 kmph during the morning. Light to moderate rainfall is expected along with possible hailstorms in the region. Residents are advised to remain cautious during thunderstorms and strong winds. The air quality in Delhi has also deteriorated to the poor category recently.
title: IMD issues yellow alert for Delhi-NCR; rain, thunderstorms & hailstorms likely

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amazon has confirmed plans to cut approximately 250 jobs in its devices and services division. These layoffs follow recent product launches, including new Kindle e-readers and tablet computers. This decision aims to improve operational efficiency and align with the company’s product roadmap. Earlier this year, Amazon announced significant job reductions, further indicating structural changes within the organization.
title: Amazon layoffs hit devices and services unit, email cites ‘review of our structure’

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Lockie Ferguson, New Zealand's fast bowler, is out of the ongoing T20I series against India due to a calf injury. With India already leading 3-0, the team has summoned Matt Fisher to enhance their bowling strength. Concurrently, Matt Henry is on the mend from a quadricep injury but is expected to rejoin for the upcoming ODI clashes.
title: Big setback for New Zealand! Star player ruled out of India T20I series

author: RAJESH PANSARE
description: While Abhishek’s century was the headline act, Sooryavanshi’s fearless approach set the tone. The pair raced to a stunning 133-run stand in just seven overs, blowing New Zealand away. The Abhishek-Sooryavanshi partnership also offered a glimpse into the mindset of a new generation of T20 batters, one that sees every ball as a scoring opportunity.
title: Perfect pairing? Why India must stick with Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
description: A high-speed train operated by Spain’s state-owned RENFE collided with a stationary IRYO train in Toledo, killing at least 68 people.
title: Spain train crash: How a system failure and red signal led to a deadly collision

author: CHETHAN KUMAR
title: Antarctic Sea ice decline makes key ocean water mass saltier, raises warming concerns

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Nestled in the breathtaking Garhwal Himalayas, Gurudwara Hemkund Sahib stands as a sacred destination for Sikh devotees. Perched at a height of 4,632 meters, it is encircled by seven majestic peaks and a serene glacial lake. Pilgrims undertake a challenging 19-kilometre trek to reach this holy site, which is currently enhancing accessibility with a new ropeway project.
title: Sacred 15,000-ft Uttarakhand Gurudwara needs 19-km Himalayan trek

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Sunshine Buns has successfully secured $7 million in Series A funding, allowing them to broaden their store presence. Founded by four friends using a family cinnamon roll recipe, their frozen delights are now featured in major retailers like Target and Costco. This new funding will support production and marketing efforts, and the founders attribute their success to local mentors and the nurturing startup community in Utah.
title: Four friends turned homemade cinnamon rolls into a $7m business on Target shelves

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Ravichandran Ashwin has urged fans and experts to be patient with young player Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. He believes Sooryavanshi showcased his talent in the latest T20I match, contributing to India's successful chase. Meanwhile, Ashwin has suggested that Sanju Samson should reclaim his opening position if Ishan Kishan re-enters the lineup. Ashwin expressed concern over the expectations placed on Sooryavanshi at such a young age.
title: ‘Vaibhav heads out’: Ashwin’s blunt call on Sooryavanshi if Ishan Kishan returns

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Kumar Sangakkara recently recounted a distressing experience involving alleged discrimination by Ryanair staff at Dublin airport. He found the encounter shocking and used social media to connect with others who faced similar situations. This incident has sparked a significant dialogue about the issues of anti-Asian racism and xenophobia in Ireland, while Ryanair remains silent regarding these serious claims.
title: ‘Threatened and discriminated’: Sangakkara alleges discrimination by staff in Dublin

title: Eye on Punjab poll, BJP fields Hardeep Puri for RS from Madhya Pradesh

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: Employees at Punjab National Bank's Aichhar branch are under investigation due to allegations of financial misconduct. Account holders have accused bank staff of embezzling approximately Rs 35 crore through unauthorized transactions. At least 16 account holders, primarily farmers, have filed complaints regarding the matter with local police. The bank has suspended five staff members, including the branch manager, while initiating an internal inquiry.
title: Farmers claim Rs 35 cr missing from PNB FDs in Greater Noida; 5 suspended

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: In the recent Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections, the Bharatiya Janata Party and Samajwadi Party faced a close contest. The BJP secured six seats against the SP's five in the elections for 11 available constituencies. Among the graduates' and teachers' seats, significant victories were recorded by both parties. Independent candidates also made their mark by winning two teacher seats before joining the BJP and SP.
title: UP MLC polls: BJP, SP finish with 6-5 scoreline; five key takeaways

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An ancient iron cauldron, potentially from the medieval or Iron Age, was found submerged under water. Underwater archaeologist Gary Bankhead led a team of divers in this ambitious recovery mission. Experts are currently investigating the cauldron's design and historical relevance. This intriguing find prompts speculation about its origin and journey into the river, with plans underway for a public exhibition at a nearby museum.
title: Diver finds centuries-old three-legged iron cauldron in England's River Wear

title: Megan Fox's $5m Malibu home defects case reportedly settled for $100k in 2021

title: Spain train collision sparks protests, calls for transport minister’s resignation

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Florida homeowner paid his outstanding homeowners' association fees five days after his property was sold at a foreclosure auction in October 2024. The sale was subsequently cancelled, but the winning bidder challenged the decision, saying it had not been heard. Nearly two years later, a Florida appeals court overturned the cancellation and ordered a fresh hearing.
title: Florida court reverses HOA auction cancellation made without hearing buyer
